source.name: Red Bull Racing Honda – Charging On To 2024 With TAG Heuer
source.quote: Red Bull Racing Honda and TAG Heuer are pleased to announce a partnership extension until 2024, with the legendary Swiss watch manufacturer continuing as the Team’s Official Timekeeper

note: TAG Heuer has partnered with Red Bull Racing since 2016 as Official Timekeeper; the April 2021 extension ran to 2024. Current-term end not announced.
